title: Telescope construction from a given supported compact detector
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $V\subseteq Y$ an open subset, and $T=Y\setminus V$. Write $\mathcal D$ for the full subcategory of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category] on complexes whose cohomology stalks vanish on $V$. Assume the corresponding ambient object property is triangulated [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Let $E,Q\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ have cohomology stalks zero on $V$. Assume $E$ is compact [def-pc-compact-object] in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$, using its coproducts [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], and that for every $K\in\mathcal D$, $K$ is zero if and only if $\operatorname{Hom}(E[n],K)=0$ for all $n\in\mathbb Z$ [def-pc-generators]. Then there are objects $X_n\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ and morphisms $t_n:X_n\to X_{n+1}$, with $X_0$ zero, such that each $t_n$ fits into an ambient distinguished triangle $X_n\to X_{n+1}\to\bigoplus_{i\in I_n}E[m_{n,i}]\to X_n[1]$. There is an ambient coproduct cofan $S=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb N}X_n$ and morphisms $s:S\to S$, $q:S\to Q$, $r:Q\to S[1]$, with $\iota_n s=t_n\iota_{n+1}$ and $S\xrightarrow{1-s}S\xrightarrow{q}Q\xrightarrow{r}S[1]$ distinguished. The sets $I_n$ lie in the same universe as the scheme and its module sheaves; the chosen localization morphism universe is arbitrary.

proof.text: Let $P$ be the property of quasi-coherent complexes whose cohomology stalks vanish on $V$. The supplied triangulated-closure hypothesis gives its full subcategory $\mathcal D$ the inherited triangulated structure, and the supplied support hypotheses put $E$ and $Q$ in $\mathcal D$.

proof.text: By [lem-pc-derived-ambient-direct-sums], cohomology of an ambient coproduct is the coproduct of cohomology sheaves. By [lem-pc-stalk-direct-sums], its stalk at a point of $V$ is a direct sum of zero stalks, hence zero. By [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums], quasi-coherence is preserved. Thus $\mathcal D$ has coproducts computed in the ambient derived category and in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$.

proof.text: The small-site K-injective resolutions of [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] apply to the ringed site of opens of $Y$. Represent the source by a complex and resolve the target by a K-injective complex. The localization map from chain maps to derived morphisms is surjective, since morphisms into a K-injective are homotopy classes of chain maps (Mathlib, CochainComplex.IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective). Chain maps between sheaves of $u$-small modules form a $u$-small set, so each derived Hom is $u$-small as a quotient. Transfer the supported triangulated category to its equivalent model with $u$-small Hom sets before applying the compact-generator theorem in the next step. Its coproducts and resulting indexing sets then have universe $u$, independently of the chosen localization universe.

The Hom groups in a full subcategory are the ambient Hom groups, and the coproducts agree. Thus the assumed compactness of $E$ in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(Y)$ gives compactness in $\mathcal D$, and the supplied shifted-Hom detection equivalence makes $\{E\}$ a generating family [def-pc-generators]. Apply [lem-pc-compact-generators-build-objects] to this singleton family and $Q$. It gives $A_0\to A_1\to\cdots$ with $A_0$ a sum of shifts and triangles $Z_n\to A_n\to A_{n+1}\to Z_n[1]$, with $Z_n$ a sum of shifts, and the telescope triangle ending in $Q$.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: Rotate each transition triangle once to obtain $A_n\to A_{n+1}\to Z_n[1]\to A_n[1]$. The shift equivalence preserves coproducts, so its third object is a sum of $E[m+1]$. Apply the inherited exact inclusion to obtain ambient distinguished triangles and ambient colimiting cofans.

source.place: Section Tag 0E4G, lemma-when-sheafy, proof of (3); derived.tex, lemma-write-as-colimit (Tag 09SN)

proof.text: Set $X_0=0$ and $X_{n+1}=A_n$. For the first transition use $0\to A_0\xrightarrow{1}A_0\to0[1]$. The coproduct of $(X_n)$ is canonically isomorphic to that of $(A_n)$ by deleting the zero summand and relabelling $n+1$ as $n$. Checking on coprojections shows that this isomorphism intertwines the two transition endomorphisms. Transport the telescope triangle along it, and reindex the ULift coproduct by $\mathbb N$. This gives the stated cofan $S$, the map $s$ satisfying $\iota_n s=t_n\iota_{n+1}$, and the triangle with $1-s$.

theorem supported_derived_generated_perfect_core (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (V : Y.Opens) (E Q : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (htri : ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (fun K : schemeDerivedCategory Y ↦
      schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y K ∧
        ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ →
          Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K).val.presheaf y))))
    (hcompact :
      letI : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y
      IsCompactObject E)
    (hsupport : ∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj E.obj).val.presheaf y)))
    (hgen : ∀ K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y,
      (∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ →
        Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj K.obj).val.presheaf y))) →
      (IsZero K.obj ↔ ∀ n : ℤ, Subsingleton (E.obj⟦n⟧ ⟶ K.obj))) :
    (∀ (k : ℤ) (y : Y), y ∉ (V : Set Y)ᶜ →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) k).obj Q.obj).val.presheaf y))) →
      ∃ (X : ℕ → schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
        (t : ∀ n : ℕ, (X n).obj ⟶ (X (n + 1)).obj),
        IsZero (X 0).obj ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (I : Type u) (m : I → ℤ)
          (C : Cofan (fun i : I ↦ E.obj⟦m i⟧)), Nonempty (IsColimit C) ∧
          ∃ (a : (X (n + 1)).obj ⟶ C.pt)
            (b : C.pt ⟶ (X n).obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            Triangle.mk (t n) a b ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y)) ∧
        ∃ (S : Cofan (fun n : ℕ ↦ (X n).obj)), Nonempty (IsColimit S) ∧
          ∃ (s : S.pt ⟶ S.pt) (q : S.pt ⟶ Q.obj)
            (r : Q.obj ⟶ S.pt⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
            (∀ n : ℕ, S.inj n ≫ s = t n ≫ S.inj (n + 1)) ∧
            Triangle.mk (𝟙 S.pt - s) q r ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Y)
